narrative: Nvidia is widening past data-center GPUs into Windows AI PCs with the RTX Spark superchip, direct movement on the deskside on-device silicon leg, while the same day's Flowise coverage and Obsidian's case for confining tool execution to an isolated runtime reinforce the paired sandbox-runtime concern. Both legs of the driving rationale are advancing.
remaining_gap: The two halves advance on separate threads rather than as one integrated deskside-plus-sandbox product, and no peer silicon vendor has published matching specs.
